craft_notes: Sthāyin: maṅgala-bhakti of salute-and-likeness — imitation as veneration; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (door-command, terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Alone-ablaze-swallowed ring; praise (not worship — seeing). Rejected: (a) ring→circle → killed: ring closes. Read aloud: CON-scious-NESS-BHAI-ra-va a-LONE … ŚI-va I-praise.

lines: Consciousness-Bhairava alone — supreme, nectar-formed supreme, one, ablaze;
all swallowed in shining senses' ring — Śiva I praise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: cidbhairavam eva paraṃ paramāmṛtarūpam | ekam atidīptam

reads_against.argmap: Which Bhairava is venerated? → Alone supreme nectar-one, all-swallowed: venerated.
c1_essence: Alone supreme nectar-one ablaze, all-swallowed: venerated.
Melted bliss-mass; principle likened in form venerated.
Script-outlines man; shape reveals varied You.
Light-goddess-flowers arranged; guru unfolded, heart entered.
Reflecting praise in body-temple, bonds outpoured.
Five-named conquer; splits gained, mouths called.
